notes.title: Huge update for Zombie Road Rider! New maps and new zombies!
notes.content:
Hi people!

[b]Zombie Road Rider[/b] has received a [b]huge update[/b] that was on the work for some times now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1175640/Zombie_Road_Rider/

Actually, the game has received a series of updates since the last news that was posted last year ago! So what is new?

A full new environment to play! The [b]City Downtown[/b] ! Set in an environment made of skyscrapers and large roads, save the survivors who are running around and bring them to the safe house!

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33866305/95a0d1b7264481b6ac5e137bf3a7d2fe666b76aa.jpg[/img]

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33866305/8f4e97a8c6bfae9a50ea725db8a7de4d3c9d0064.jpg[/img]

Another new environment, the [b]Industrial Town[/b]! Set in narrow streets with old industrial style buildings, largely populated with fully physics-based props, obstacles and zombies to road ride!

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33866305/98f1e6fe837711a742a3775547dfccf23bc79310.jpg[/img]

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33866305/fee8a8ddef73791dcacdc55f7d52fc7fca266e03.jpg[/img]

[b]The Factory[/b], a modern industrial type place with barricades and zombies to destroy!

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33866305/ade6a5df7052809be50173755ebab3f195d6ac41.jpg[/img]

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33866305/a7e51c4dc1321136d3d203c7e5a49f4ee1aa8802.jpg[/img]

Another one main new aspect of the game is that [b]+30 zombies were added [/b]to replace the old classic one, so that the game has more variety of characters!

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33866305/d026c4dfa1436d565e546f9a344a423bbf313c46.jpg[/img]

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33866305/79c36fe1d10ef8ab1a5221af2a1626267cdd9578.jpg[/img]

[b]Physics of the cars and vehicles were reworked[/b] to feel more enjoyable and powerful against the obstacles and zombies on the road. Improvements were made on the graphics and the optimisation of the game to have it run more smoothly. The menu and user interface was also reworked to be more intuitive and easier to use.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0qe6t-gvPVg

The environments that were added have support for both rescue and freeride game mode!

So this pretty sum up all what you will find in this large update! I hope you will enjoy!

Best,
Devdan

notes.title: Gameplay Update for Action Alien Tropical (April 2020)
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33866305/d0667a79ac504f4facd74dbe04aba3cc9af4d55e.png[/img]

This week an update has been pushed for the game which provides :

[b]Changes in the gameplay.[/b] 
[list]
[*] Ammo and bombs are now located in the islands. This gives more ability to complete the game by searching the islands!
[*] Aliens will now spawn differently on the islands. Some of them will be roaming around while others will be rushing at you!
[*] Changes with the ambient music and fix for sounds effects
[*] Fix for the aliens soldiers AI
[*] Changes in the HUD map display
[*] ...
[/list]

[b]Optimization[/b]
[list]
[*] Optimization for the islands, bungalows and foliage which result in an increase of FPS!
[/list]

[b]Fix for Steam achievements[/b] being unlocked the wrong way!


https://store.steampowered.com/app/810800/Action_Alien_Tropical
More updates may come in the future, when needing to fix some issues or simply to improve the game !

Best!
[i]Devdan[/i]

notes.title: Action Alien: Prelude is now available ! Gameplay video
notes.content:
[b]Action Alien: Prelude[/b] has been released on Steam and is now available !

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31661908/36cf28edb4d578950c83a0f231a34c535265a842.jpg[/img]

With a small price of [b]$0.99[/b], the game is featuring hordes of aliens breaking on the petrol station which will need to be contained until you manage to collect enough petrol cans to leave the place with your car !

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31661908/fb8a5bf6b5b9427406add5e3127f34ec4357111e.jpg[/img]

The petrol station is surrounded by the desert and can be entirely destroyed with machine guns, explosives, and by the aliens coming in waves from all sides.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31661908/3e979a83eaa887f73d80b42567976ec24e1e557e.jpg[/img]

Dispersed at various spots inside the station, weapons ranging from the revolver, shotgun, tommy gun, grenade launcher, etc... will be appearing each time you defeat an alien wave, along ammo boxes, grenades and medkits.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31661908/bfd636d36c88001377f4c84dcd97f2c9c1a5c5f9.jpg[/img]

Aliens are coming as different species and they will run at you, walk loudly, spit acid and come from different places to get you.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31661908/ecc3db33dcc23f4410942b72c22c8a842cff16a6.jpg[/img]

To give a bit more of replayability, the game can be played in daylight but also at night. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31661908/d299d84ed4585fa60f6f0cb4c131476eba532f45.jpg[/img]

The game has 10 achievements to unlock, with support for Xbox-like gamepads along Ultra HD resolution (4K).

A gameplay video is also available to have a preview of in-game action.
https://youtu.be/1lS7MCLuHBE
[b]Changes in the gameplay of Action Alien: Prelude are[/b]
[list]
    [*]Destructible buildings.
    [*]Brighter graphics.
    [*]Ability to crouch.
    [*]Wave-based gameplay.
    [*]No more crates with unlimited ammunition but ammo boxes, medkits and grenades to find after each alien wave.
    [*]Weapons are more powerful, accurate and are faster to reload.
    [*]Grenades are faster to throw.
    [*]Head view movements.
    [*]Intro and ending cinematics.
    [*]and some more...
[/list]
More details about the development can be found in this forum post : http://steamcommunity.com/app/773330/discussions/0/1699416432426742238/

Thanks for reading,
[i]Devdan[/i]
http://devdangames.com

notes.title: Action Alien: Prelude coming soon !
notes.content:
For the beginning of this year 2018, a new game based on Action Alien will be released named [b]Action Alien: Prelude[/b].

[b]It is a return to the initial version of Action Alien back to when it was announced at Greenlight in 2014 ![/b] During the development of Action Alien, and even years after it was launched in 2015, the game has received many updates and changes in its core features.

These changes were done to improve the game and make it better for people who had already bought it, but it has changed the game so much that the Action Alien of 2018 has nothing to do with the one from 2014, and this is what Action Alien: Prelude is bringing back.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31661908/08041156c77ba0af6ece9a76a9460e6e687dcef3.jpg[/img]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31661908/8a5a4dd0496eebe7f271c62e0acc3ad9e98abbfd.jpg[/img]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31661908/adae9519b4d79ebf103c809a820b08af43fed4c1.jpg[/img]

[b]The main features brought back are these ones :[/b]
[list]
    [*]Bright and smooth graphics
    [*]Cans collecting gameplay
    [*]The petrol station map in its initial design with cinematic
    [*]Day and night mode
[/list]

Of course it would have been too harsh to just release the game in this state, it is why [b]work has been done to improve the game without altering it too much, these improvements are :[/b]
[list]
    [*]All bug fixes and patches of Action Alien from 2015 to 2017 implemented into Action Alien: Prelude
    [*]Added fully destructible buildings and props to the petrol station
    [*]Added achievements, Steam cloud, xbox-like controllers support and 4k resolution
    [*]A lot of tweaks on the gameplay, weapons and controls to be best fitted for the petrol station map.
[/list]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31661908/a8ac79892586bdc6724e87b60fbcbf3ddd0e8a24.jpg[/img]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31661908/0350e38aaf06defeb6dc2d5499c8f054d9aea129.jpg[/img]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31661908/f033825a52fdaa0c16cf032a667af108fd430f1e.jpg[/img]

The game is still being tested and enhanced, it should come soon on Steam.

It will of course be available for a [b]much cheaper price compared to Action Alien[/b], and trading cards will be added as soon as possible.

https://youtu.be/OPRwmrU62Ig
[h1]So check the Steam store page and add it to your wish-list to not miss the release ![/h1]

Thanks for reading,
[i]Devdan[/i]
http://devdangames.com
